question: Approve the design and enter implementation as Pilot? Approving accepts the recommendations D1 (ship although the reviewer found 3 of the 4 named defects, and record the miss: the cycle-1 text Refresh button), D2 (run the reviewer again after a MAJOR is fixed, at most twice), D3 (Sonnet as the reviewer), and FO's implementation order below.

artifacts.summary: Design: a Surfaces: ui ideation dispatches one Sonnet reviewer with a packaged brief over its previews; a shape-locked design_review report; one disposition line per finding; design_surfaces.py check refuses an unreviewed ui ideation. Reviewer choice: packaged brief (design:design-critique is not on every adopter; ui-verify checks only expected values). Replay, nine runs, pre-registered: brief v2 names the duplicated count, crowded chrome, opposite chevrons and the cycle-3 phone refresh defect, not the cycle-1 Refresh button; v2 was written after v1 missed, so it is fitted; one run per cell. Cost 84k to 101k tokens per run. Words: ui ideation gate 346 to 359; workflow.md untouched. Prototype 103 of 103 tests. Implementation order (FO, from the six Batch overlap sections): workflow-budget-ratchet and prod-security-validation-gate first in parallel; after the ratchet merges, worker-loads-declared-package, ui-design-review-in-ideation and special-role-triggers; merge-gatekeeper after prod-security-validation-gate (both edit delivery_gate.py). At most three workers at once.
